paragraphs: From Tuam test centre, pull out onto the R332 and take a slight left to stay on the R332
At the end of the road turn right onto Ballygaddy Road
At the roundabout turn left to continue on Ballygaddy Road, then at the next end of road turn left, still on Ballygaddy Road
Take the next right into Cois Na h-Abhainn, a quiet housing estate often used for practicing manoeuvres
Follow the road around to the left, and when instructed, perform a turnabout (U-turn) safely before making your way back out
Retrace your route through the estate, keeping right at the junctions
Turn right onto Ballygaddy Road turn right onto Milltown Road
Take a slight left into Church View for another quiet residential section
Come back out, continuing straight as the road becomes Vicar Street turn right onto Bishop Street
Take a slight left onto Dunmore Road, and turn right into College Green for a further practice area
Leaving College Green, complete a U-turn, then at the end of the road turn right onto Dunmore Road
Turn left onto Bobby Burke Road and approach the roundabout, taking a slight left to join Milltown Road (effectively the 1st or 2nd exit depending on layout)
Continue straight through the next roundabout, staying on Milltown Road
Rejoin Milltown Road and at the next roundabout take the slight left onto the Tuam Bypass
Follow the bypass for about 1.7km take the off-ramp slight left, continuing left onto Ballygaddy Road
At the roundabout turn right to stay on Ballygaddy Road
Turn left into an unnamed side road for another U-turn practice
Head back out, take a slight left onto the R332, then at the end of the road turn left onto Ballygaddy Road
Turn left onto the L6525, left again onto Belclare ED, and finally right onto the L2105 before arriving back at the finish point near Tuam test centre
